findings.title: Excessive Data Exposure on /users/me
findings.impact: Credential or cryptographic material was exposed in client-accessible JSON. Sensitive fields detected: creditScore, internalNotes, passwordHash.
findings.remediation: Implement selective response projection or Data Transfer Objects (DTOs) to ensure only fields documented in the API specification are returned to the client.

findings.title: Broken Object Level Authorization on /orders/{order_id}
findings.impact: Authenticated user 'userA' can access private resource #102 belonging to 'userB'. The server returned full object details without checking caller ownership.
findings.remediation: Implement resource-level authorization checks. Before serving data for /orders/{order_id}, verify that the requested object's owner ID equals the authenticated user ID.

findings.title: Broken Authentication on /auth/logout
findings.impact: Endpoint '/auth/logout' is declared as secured by BearerAuth in OpenAPI, yet allows completely unauthenticated anonymous requests to read confidential data.
findings.remediation: Ensure authentication middleware or dependency injection is applied to this route handler.

findings.title: Broken Authentication on /invoices
findings.impact: Endpoint '/invoices' is declared as secured by BearerAuth in OpenAPI, yet allows completely unauthenticated anonymous requests to read confidential data.
findings.remediation: Ensure authentication middleware or dependency injection is applied to this route handler.

findings.title: Broken Function Level Authorization on /admin/users
findings.impact: Standard user 'userA' was able to access administrative endpoint '/admin/users'.
findings.remediation: Enforce role-based access control (RBAC) middleware verifying administrator privilege.

findings.title: Missing Rate Limiting on Authentication Endpoint
findings.impact: Endpoint '/auth/login' accepted 20 rapid sequential login attempts without returning HTTP 429 Too Many Requests or rate limiting headers, allowing automated brute-force attacks.
findings.remediation: Configure rate-limiting middleware (e.g. max 5 login attempts per IP/account per minute).

findings.title: Overly Permissive CORS Reflecting Arbitrary Origin with Credentials
findings.impact: Server reflects untrusted Origin headers with Access-Control-Allow-Credentials enabled, permitting cross-site data theft.
findings.remediation: Configure an explicit allowlist of authorized web origins in CORS policy.

findings.title: Exposed Internal Debug Endpoint at /debug/config
findings.impact: The endpoint '/debug/config' is publicly reachable and returns internal configuration secrets or operational diagnostics.
findings.remediation: Disable debug endpoints in non-development environments or protect /debug/config behind private network boundaries.
